me.colorlight.command.engine_off: The engine has not been initialized yet
me.colorlight.general.enable.tooltip: Enable or disable automatic colored block lighting.
me.colorlight.general.light_range.toolti: Maximum distance that colored light can spread.
me.colorlight.general.use_gpu_lighting.t: Uses a GPU compute shader instead of the CPU to calculate colored light propagation. A small test runs automatically on startup; if the GPU or driver fails or produces an incorrect result, the mod silently falls back to the CPU.
me.colorlight.general.smooth_lighting.to: Blends colored light between neighboring blocks at each vertex for a softer appearance. When disabled, each face uses a single sample instead, which is cheaper. The setting works the same whether lighting is computed on the CPU or GPU.
me.colorlight.compatibility.entity_track: Master switch for scanning entities for glowing blocks held or worn by them. Disable it to turn this feature off completely.
me.colorlight.compatibility.entity_follo: Uses the client's render distance, in chunks, as the radius for scanning entities for glowing blocks they hold or wear. Disable this to use a fixed radius.
me.colorlight.compatibility.entity_check: Radius, in chunks, used to scan entities for glowing blocks they hold or wear. Only used when “Follow render distance” is disabled.
me.colorlight.compatibility.voxy_compat_: Master switch for the colored-light glow overlay on Voxy's LOD terrain. Disable it to turn this feature off completely.
me.colorlight.compatibility.voxy_follow_: Uses Voxy's configured LOD render distance as the range for displaying colored-light glow overlays on LOD terrain. Disable this to use a fixed range.
me.colorlight.compatibility.voxy_light_r: Distance, in blocks, from the camera within which colored-light sources receive a glow overlay on Voxy's LOD terrain. Only used when “Follow Voxy's LOD render distance” is disabled.
